name: Recon-ng host discovery
description: Runs one of three allowlisted Recon-ng domain-to-host modules (hackertarget, certificate transparency, threatcrowd). Profile, contact and credential modules cannot be invoked.
externalRestrictions: The chosen module must already be installed in Recon-ng; Ghost does not run its marketplace installer. Recon-ng is GPL software run as a separate program. Anything about individuals (email addresses, usernames, people, social profiles) is discarded by design; the tool is run with a fixed allowlist, so those modules cannot be selected. It is a separate program, not part of Mayfair: Ghost downloads it into its tools folder on first use (checksum verified, then tested) or you point Ghost at your own copy. It is shown as installed only after its own self-test passes.
